environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Untimed diagnostic only; main-thread V8 samples exclude native libvips execution. Sharp metadata/toBuffer/stats promise durations include async overlap and preload/log overhead: do not add them to infer wall-clock CPU or attribute native time to decoding vs encoding. Worker --import runs outside timed studies. Trace records operation count and encoded input bytes submitted; copies are not inferred from elapsed time. Full local CPU profiles retained by digest. No diagnostic values enter benchmark medians.
